concepts.learning_objective: Describe Sophie's fanciful ambitions and what they reveal about her as a school-leaver.
Contrast Jansie's practical view of their future with Sophie's daydreams.
Identify A. R. Barton's theme of adolescent fantasising and hero worship.
Infer the family's working-class background from details of their home and talk.
Describe the temperament of Sophie's father and his attitude to her stories.
Describe Geoff's work and his silent, reserved nature.
Explain why Geoff represents the wider, unknown world that Sophie longs to enter.

topics.title: The Danny Casey story and hero worship

concepts.learning_objective: Recall and evaluate Sophie's account of meeting Danny Casey in the arcade.
Explain how the family's admiration for United and Casey shows hero worship.

topics.title: Waiting by the canal: fantasy and reality

concepts.learning_objective: Trace how Sophie's hope turns into doubt and sadness as she waits by the canal.
Analyse how the ending suggests the meeting with Casey was imagined.
Explain the non-literal meaning of expressions used in the story.
Identify present participles used to show two actions happening at the same time.
Give the meaning of informal words such as chuffed, nosey and gawky.
